purpose: Connect bounded strategy proposals, frozen evidence, prospective observation and controlled promotion review without changing the deployed trader.
implemented: Existing validated DNA templates remain the only candidate-generation mechanism; no arbitrary generated code or uncontrolled retraining.
Selection uses training results only; separate historical holdout and doubled modeled-friction screens can reject the selected candidate.
One eligible trial is copied outside the four rotating research batches and retains its frozen rules, source protocol, evidence hashes, policy and deadline.
Forward outcomes must start after the freeze, remain chronological and nonoverlapping, and resolve before the observation deadline.
Two separate 30-trade forward stages plus at least 100 total shadow observations are required for independent validation review.
Base and stressed mean return must be positive, profit factor at least 1.1 when losses exist, and research drawdown no more than 6R.
Rule drift, altered evidence, source mismatch, coverage gaps or excess drawdown quarantine the research trial.
No qualifying activity by the 28-day deadline is insufficient evidence, never a reason to force broker trades.
Failed and expired trials are archived intact before a later bounded research batch may select a replacement; successful shadow trials stay pinned for review.
Shared research status and Brain v2 typed/voice answers expose the governed trial without granting execution authority.

deployment_validation.account_preflight: Configured demo account matched; no open positions or pending orders before restart.
deployment_validation.services: Backend, UI and existing active voice listener reloaded; backend reconnected and fresh heartbeat observed; microphone ready.

fresh_research_cycle.reason: Separate historical base or cost-stress screen failed.

remaining_evidence_and_activation_requir: A candidate must actually qualify; no profitable replacement is asserted.
Future forward observations cannot be manufactured or completed immediately.
The generated-rule simulator is not a full live-gate replay and uses hypothetical costs without a complete commission model.
Broker-unit cost calibration and independent live-gate parity validation remain required before promotion review.
The current top-down M5 path does not automatically load generated evolved rules; a qualified candidate requires a reviewed integration before broker use.
Passing shadow screens never enables a broker adapter, changes the current trader, or constitutes permission to activate a model.
